func:
const st = global.get("tanque_state") || {
  conectado: false, host: "192.168.1.10", port: 4840, modo: "PID",
  sistema_activo: true, di_start: false, di_stop: false,
  usar_pot_fio: false, descarga_auto: true, setpoint_pct: 50.0,
  nivel_pct: 0.0, nivel_cm: 0.0, nivel_v: 0.0, flow_v: 0.0,
  fill_pct: 0.0, discharge_pct: 35.0, kp: 3.2, ki: 0.25, kd: 1.8,
  last_rx: 0, registrando_csv: true, muestras_guardadas: 0,
  hist_t: [], hist_sp: [], hist_pv: [], hist_fill: [], hist_desc: []
};
const online = Boolean(st.last_rx && (Date.now() - st.last_rx) < 3000);
msg.payload = {
  conectado: online,
  host: "192.168.1.10",
  port: 4840,
  modo: st.modo,
  sistema_activo: st.sistema_activo,
  di_start: st.di_start,
  di_stop: st.di_stop,
  usar_pot_fio: st.usar_pot_fio,
  descarga_auto: st.descarga_auto,
  setpoint_pct: st.setpoint_pct,
  nivel_pct: st.nivel_pct,
  nivel_cm: st.nivel_cm,
  nivel_v: st.nivel_v,
  flow_v: st.flow_v,
  fill_pct: st.fill_pct,
  discharge_pct: st.discharge_pct,
  kp: st.kp,
  ki: st.ki,
  kd: st.kd,
  registrando_csv: st.registrando_csv,
  muestras_guardadas: st.muestras_guardadas,
  hist_t: st.hist_t,
  hist_sp: st.hist_sp,
  hist_pv: st.hist_pv,
  hist_fill: st.hist_fill,
  hist_desc: st.hist_desc
};
msg.headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store" };
return msg;
